concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI in plan.md mandates the 'Kolmogorov–Smirnov test' for PIT uniformity. This directly contradicts Spec FR-004 and SC-002, which explicitly require the 'Ljung-Box test' to account for autocorrelation. The plan fails to back the spec's mandatory requirement, risking a methodological failure in the implementation.

Constitution Principle VI in plan.md lists 'Ljung-Box (not KS)' in the 'Plan Alignment' column but the 'Requirement' column text still reads 'Kolmogorov–Smirnov test'. This internal contradiction in the plan document creates ambiguity about the actual required test, failing to clearly back the spec's FR-004/SC-002 mandate for Ljung-Box.
